caption: Exact-match and similarity rates over 5 identical seeded requests per model at temperature 0.7. This number, and not an assumption, determines the reproducibility level the paper may claim.
alt_text: Exact-match and similarity rates over 5 identical seeded requests per model at temperature 0.7. This number, and not an assumption, determines the reproducibility level the paper may claim.
limitations: Five identical seeded requests at temperature 0.7 and 128 tokens. This is not the reproducibility of a 12-turnover trajectory at T=0.3 or T=1.0. Exact-match rate is the level of seeded determinism an arm may claim for this probe; it does not make outputs interchangeable.
